plugin.name: game-keys
plugin._long: Lets the function keys among the desktop's shortcuts through to games: pressed alone while a full screen window or a game is focused, such a key goes to that window instead of doing the shortcut.

option.name: keys
option._long: The function keys to let through, such as "KEY_F3 KEY_F11".

option.name: programs
option._long: App IDs (an X11 program's WM_CLASS) of games that get the keys while not full screen, separated by spaces; * matches anything.

option.name: all_x11
option._long: Every X11 program gets the keys, as games run under Wine do.
